downloadIntro.zh: 当前版本 v1.53.30。选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: The current release is v1.53.30. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 图表画线工具新增风险回报规划：两次点击确定进场和止损，自动生成 1:1 初始止盈区域，可拖动调整并显示价格、距离、百分比和盈亏比。
highlights.en: Added a risk/reward planning tool: two clicks set entry and stop, create an initial 1:1 target, and show draggable prices, distances, percentages, and risk/reward.

highlights.zh: 指标库新增 ZigZag，支持转折深度、最小偏差和 Backstep，并提供公式参考及末端重绘提示。
highlights.en: Added ZigZag with Pivot Depth, Minimum Deviation, Backstep, formula guidance, and a warning that the provisional endpoint may repaint.

highlights.zh: 交易系统结构化条件现在可引用同一根 K 线的开、高、低、收、成交量、持仓量和点差。
highlights.en: Structured trading-system conditions can now reference same-bar open, high, low, close, volume, open interest, and spread fields.

highlights.zh: 优化大屏幕下“复盘习惯”卡片的高度与间距，减少无效空白；全局数字改用更清晰的普通 0，并继续保持等宽对齐。
highlights.en: Improved the review-habit card height and spacing on large screens, and adopted clearer plain-zero numerals while preserving tabular alignment.

highlights.zh: 修复免费版白银 AG、螺纹钢 RB 数据权限异常，恢复最近一年数据的下载、更新和训练。
highlights.en: Fixed an entitlement issue affecting free access to the latest year of AG silver and RB rebar data for downloads, updates, and training.
